notes.title: Pre-purchase FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles Now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1004640/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9108781/0028b7f4e30f7ec79653ea57ab36391aafa576ca.jpg[/img]

Ivalice—a kingdom blessed by the light of the gods and ruled by the Two-headed Lion. A year after her defeat to Ordallia in the Fifty Years' War, the king succumbed to malady, leaving a mere boy of two to ascend the throne.

Whoever was named regent would rule in truth, and thus emerged two rival candidates: dukes Goltanna and Larg, whose deeds during the war had earned them great renown. Goltanna the Black Lion and Larg the White Lion were destined to clash, and the resulting conflict would come to be known as the War of the Lions.

Against this backdrop appear Ramza, third son of House Beoulve, one of Ivalice's leading military families, and his childhood companion Delita, a commoner raised amongst nobles. As they endeavor to chart a course through this tumultuous age, a mighty current draws them ever closer to the abyss.

[h3]Pre-order Bonuses[/h3]
By pre-ordering, you will receive the following bonus items:  
[list]
[*]  White Equipment for Ramza 
[*]  Weapon: Mythril Knife 
[*]  Accessory: Spiked Boots (Increase a unit's Jump attribute while equipped) 
[*]  Consumable items: High Potion x10 
[*]  Consumable items: Ether x10 
[/list]
*These items can be obtained by pre-ordering the game, and will not be included with purchases made on or after the game’s release date.
*An internet connection is required to receive the bonus items.
*Bonus items can be obtained from the Options section of the main menu once it becomes available after starting a new game.
*Ramza's alternate equipment colors can be applied from his status screen under the Units section of the main menu.
*Certain bonuses can also be obtained by playing through the game.
*Bonus items may be distributed to players or made available for purchase at a later date.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9108781/ea8c2082a0b569fc1b9f092c81d7e80a85fa5c7d.png[/img]

The Deluxe Edition includes the following bonuses:

[/list]

*Bonuses can be obtained from the Options section of the main menu once it becomes available after starting a new game.
*Ramza's alternate equipment colors can be applied from his status screen under the Units section of the main menu.

*Bonuses may be distributed to players or made available for purchase at a later date.

notes.title: Further update: Issues with Monitors using G-SYNC
notes.content:
This a follow-up to the early announcement we posted on 14th February 2018, which was entitled as “Issues with Monitors using G-SYNC”.

We requested NVIDIA to investigate the issue and they have come back with the following report.

“This is an issue that can occur in games on fixed-FPS such as FINAL FANTASY XII THE ZODIAC AGE, due to the current design specifications of G-SYNC.
Please disable G-SYNC by following the steps as specified below.” 

<How to fix the issue>
Step1:  NVIDIA control panel-> Manage 3D Settings -> Open “Program Settings” tab

Step2:  Select FINAL FANTASY XII THE ZODIAC AGE from “Select the program to customize”

Step3:  Set the monitor technology to the specified fixed refresh rate in “Specify the settings for this program”
